verdict.rationale: Airweave has no documented sandbox or test mode. The closest evidence is that it can be self-hosted locally (clone and run start.sh, dashboard at localhost:8080), which gives an isolated instance for experimenting, but the docs never present this as a sandbox and sources would still sync real data. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox or test environment, test API keys or mock and sample data sources, documented separation from production data, and independent corroboration.
